notes: New in the Takeoff: Manage Pages to rename/delete pages on an uploaded print without needing consecutive selections; a Field Notes markup layer (styled text notes with a circle marker, plus arrow trace lines) that's independent of your device counts and can be included or hidden on export; a 'Build Submittal — No Counts' option to send shop drawings before a quote is done; Snips — pin a crop of any page (like a symbol legend) in its own floating, resizable window you can leave open across sessions; the device library now groups into collapsible category/subcategory dropdowns you define yourself; and per-device Candela tracking (15/30/75/110/135/177/185cd) set independently on each placed strobe, with a Candela Load Summary on export that can be scoped to selected sections.
